keywords: practical implications of weak and strict typing
subtopics: Practical implications of weak and strict typing.
learning_outcomes: Explain what understanding php's type system contributes to a PHP application.
Apply at least one of these concepts in a small example: dynamic typing.
Check one edge case and explain how to diagnose unexpected behavior.

content.intro: Reliable programs represent values deliberately. Variables hold changing values, constants name stable values, and type behavior affects comparisons, conversion, function contracts, and error handling. In this lesson, focus on dynamic typing; then compare it with type declarations. Use the example to predict a result before checking it, and record one case where the behavior may differ.
content.why_it_matters: You will use understanding php's type system when building readable, testable PHP programs. Its practical value is knowing which rule applies, what result to expect, and how to handle failure or unexpected input.

common_mistakes.problem: Copying a pattern without understanding its inputs and output.
common_mistakes.why: Small environment or type differences can change behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Trace one example by hand, name expected outputs, and consult version-matched official docs.

common_mistakes.problem: Ignoring empty, invalid, or boundary input.
common_mistakes.why: Real data rarely matches only the simplest example.
common_mistakes.fix: Add a deliberate edge-case check before relying on the result.

common_mistakes.problem: Making several changes at once while debugging.
common_mistakes.why: It becomes difficult to identify which change caused the behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Reduce the issue to one small reproducible case, change one cause, and retest.
